en.t: Alexios II is made Byzantine co-emperor
en.s: On March 4, 1171, Alexios II Komnenos, the son of Manuel I, was made co-emperor of the Byzantine Empire.
en.n: This is his appointment as co-emperor, before his sole reign began in 1180.

zh.t: 阿莱克修斯二世被立为拜占庭共治皇帝
zh.s: 1171年3月4日，曼努埃尔一世的儿子阿莱克修斯二世被立为拜占庭共治皇帝。
zh.n: 此处指他获立为共治皇帝，并非1180年继承皇位。

en.t: Mongol forces defeat Vladimir-Suzdal army at the Sit River
en.s: On March 4, 1238, Mongol forces of Batu Khan defeated the army of Vladimir-Suzdal led by Grand Prince Yuri II at the Sit River, in present-day Russia.

zh.t: 蒙古军在锡季河击败弗拉基米尔-苏兹达尔军队
zh.s: 1238年3月4日，拔都的蒙古军在锡季河击败弗拉基米尔-苏兹达尔军队，后者由大公尤里二世率领。战场位于今天的俄罗斯。

en.t: U Thong takes the throne as Ramathibodi I
en.s: On 4 March 1351, U Thong took the throne as Ramathibodi I, becoming the first king of Ayutthaya. Ayutthaya’s royal chronicle records this as the beginning of his reign.

zh.t: 乌通登基，成为阿瑜陀耶首任国王
zh.s: 1351年3月4日，乌通登基，称拉玛铁菩提一世，成为阿瑜陀耶首任国王。阿瑜陀耶王朝编年史将这一天记为他的即位日。

en.t: Władysław Jagiełło is crowned king of Poland in Kraków
en.s: On 4 March 1386, Archbishop Bodzanta crowned Władysław Jagiełło king of Poland at Wawel Cathedral in Kraków.

zh.t: 雅盖沃在克拉科夫加冕为波兰国王
zh.s: 1386年3月4日，格涅兹诺大主教博赞塔在克拉科夫的瓦维尔主教座堂为雅盖沃加冕，册立他为波兰国王。

en.t: Edward IV is declared king after Henry VI is deposed
en.s: On 4 March 1461, Henry VI was deposed and Edward IV was declared king in London. Edward’s coronation followed on 28 June.
en.n: Edward was declared king on March 4; his coronation followed on June 28, 1461.

zh.t: 亨利六世被废黜，爱德华四世宣布即位
zh.s: 1461年3月4日，亨利六世被废黜，爱德华四世在伦敦宣布即位。爱德华四世于同年6月28日加冕。
zh.n: 爱德华四世于3月4日宣布即位，直到1461年6月28日才举行加冕礼。

en.s: The capture of Breda was a short battle during the Eighty Years' War and Anglo-Spanish War (1585–1604) during which a Dutch and English army led by Maurice of Nassau captured the heavily protected city of Breda. Using a clever tactic reminiscent of the Trojan horse which became famous as the ruse with the Turfschip van Breda, a small assault force hid in a peat barge, entered the city of Breda, and proceeded to take it over resulting in a minimum number of casualties.

zh.s: 布雷达陷落是八十年战争和英西战争（1585—1604）期间的一场短暂战斗。毛里茨·范·奥兰治率领荷兰和英国联军攻占防守严密的布雷达城。联军使用了后来闻名的“布雷达泥炭船”计策，少量突击队员藏在泥炭船中进入城内并发动进攻，伤亡极少。

en.s: The naval Battle of Leghorn took place on 4 March 1653 (14 March Gregorian calendar), during the First Anglo-Dutch War, near Leghorn (Livorno), Italy. It was a victory of a Dutch fleet under Commodore Johan van Galen over an English squadron under Captain Henry Appleton. Afterward an English fleet under Captain Richard Badiley, which Appleton had been trying to reach, came up but was outnumbered and fled. In 1652 the government of the Commonwealth of England, mistakenly believing that the Dutch had been defeated at the Battle of the Kentish Knock, split their fleet between the Mediterranean and home waters.

zh.s: 第一次英荷战争期间，旧历1653年3月4日、公历3月14日，荷兰与英国舰队在意大利利沃诺附近交战。约翰·范加伦准将率荷兰舰队，击败亨利·阿普尔顿舰长指挥的英国分舰队。阿普尔顿原想会合的理查德·巴迪利舰长随后率舰抵达，但因寡不敌众而撤走。1652年，英格兰共和国政府误以为荷兰已在肯特沙洲海战中被击败，因此把舰队分驻地中海及本土海域。

en.s: The Second Anglo-Dutch War began on 4 March 1665 and concluded with the signing of the Treaty of Breda on 31 July 1667. It was the second in a series of naval wars fought between England and the Dutch Republic and it was driven largely by commercial rivalry, competition over maritime trade, and disputes over overseas colonies and trading posts.

zh.s: 第二次英荷战争于1665年3月4日爆发，1667年7月31日以签署《布雷达条约》结束。这是英格兰与荷兰共和国之间一系列海战中的第二次，主要由商业竞争、海上贸易争夺以及海外殖民地和贸易据点纠纷引发。

en.t: Charles II appoints John Flamsteed as royal astronomical observer
en.s: On 4 March 1675, Charles II appointed John Flamsteed as his “astronomical observator”, a post later known as Astronomer Royal.
en.n: The appointment was as astronomical observator; the post later became known as Astronomer Royal.

zh.t: 查理二世任命约翰·弗兰斯蒂德为王室天文观测员
zh.s: 1675年3月4日，查理二世任命约翰·弗兰斯蒂德为王室“天文观测员”，这一职位后来称为“皇家天文学家”。
zh.n: 他受任时的职位是“天文观测员”；“皇家天文学家”是后来才使用的称号。

en.s: The Battle of Sikandrabad was a military engagement between the Afghan Durranis and the Marathas near the city of Sikandrabad.

zh.s: 锡坎达拉巴德战役是杜兰尼阿富汗军队与马拉塔军队在锡坎达拉巴德城附近的一次交战。

en.s: The Fortification of Dorchester Heights was a decisive action early in the American Revolutionary War that precipitated the end of the siege of Boston and the withdrawal of British troops from that city. On March 4, 1776, troops from the Continental Army under George Washington's command occupied Dorchester Heights, a series of low hills with a commanding view of Boston and its harbor, and mounted powerful cannons there threatening the city and the Navy ships in the harbor.
en.n: This entry records the event's start date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 多切斯特高地筑垒是美国独立战争初期的一次关键行动，促使波士顿围城结束，英军撤出该城。1776年3月4日，乔治·华盛顿指挥的大陆军占领多切斯特高地。这片低矮山丘俯瞰波士顿及其港口，美军在此架设重炮，威胁城内和港口的海军舰船。
zh.n: 此条记录采用原文资料框列明的事件开始日期。

en.s: The 1st United States Congress, comprising the United States Senate and the United States House of Representatives, met from March 4, 1789, to March 4, 1791, during the first two years of George Washington's presidency, first at Federal Hall in New York City and later at Congress Hall in Philadelphia. With the initial meeting of the First Congress, the United States federal government officially began operations under the new (and current) frame of government established by the 1787 Constitution.

zh.s: 美国第一届国会由参议院及众议院组成，任期为1789年3月4日至1791年3月4日，处于乔治·华盛顿总统任期的头两年。国会最初在纽约市联邦厅开会，后来迁至费城国会厅。随着第一届国会首次开会，美国联邦政府正式开始按照1787年宪法确立、沿用至今的政体运作。

en.s: On 4 March 1794, Congress proposed the Eleventh Amendment to the U.S. Constitution. It limits lawsuits against a state in federal court by citizens of another state or foreign country; the amendment was adopted after the Supreme Court’s decision in Chisholm v. Georgia.

zh.t: 国会提出《美国宪法第十一修正案》
zh.s: 1794年3月4日，美国国会提出宪法第十一修正案。修正案限制外州公民或外国公民在联邦法院起诉某个州；提出修正案的背景是最高法院在“奇泽姆诉乔治亚州案”中的裁决。

en.s: The inauguration of John Adams as the second president of the United States was held on Saturday, March 4, 1797, in the House of Representatives Chamber of Congress Hall in Philadelphia, Pennsylvania. The inauguration marked the commencement of the only four-year term of John Adams as president and of Thomas Jefferson as vice president. The presidential oath of office was administered to John Adams by Chief Justice Oliver Ellsworth.

zh.t: 约翰·亚当斯就任美国总统
zh.s: 1797年3月4日星期六，约翰·亚当斯在宾夕法尼亚州费城国会厅的众议院会议厅，宣誓就任美国第二任总统。典礼标志着他唯一的四年总统任期，以及托马斯·杰斐逊的副总统任期开始。首席大法官奥利弗·埃尔斯沃思主持亚当斯的宣誓。

en.t: Castle Hill convict rebellion begins in New South Wales
en.s: On the evening of 4 March 1804, convicts at the Castle Hill government farm in New South Wales rose in rebellion. The fighting known as the Battle of Vinegar Hill took place the next morning, 5 March, at Rouse Hill.
en.n: This records the rebellion beginning on March 4; the Battle of Vinegar Hill followed on March 5, 1804.

zh.t: 新南威尔士州卡斯尔山囚犯起义爆发
zh.s: 1804年3月4日晚，新南威尔士州卡斯尔山政府农场的囚犯发动起义。后来称为“醋山战役”的交战于次日，即3月5日，在劳斯山一带发生。
zh.n: 此条记录的是3月4日起义爆发；“醋山战役”发生于1804年3月5日。

en.s: The Battle of Longwoods took place during the Anglo-American War of 1812. On 4 March 1814, a mounted American raiding party defeated an attempt by British regulars, volunteers from the Canadian militia and Native Americans to intercept them near Wardsville, in present-day Southwest Middlesex, Ontario.

zh.s: 朗伍兹战役发生在1812年英美战争期间。1814年3月4日，一支美国骑兵突袭队在今安大略省西南部沃兹维尔附近，击退了试图拦截他们的英国正规军、加拿大民兵志愿兵和原住民部队。

en.s: The 1844 Chicago mayoral elections is the first of only two instances in which a Chicago mayoral election was declared invalid (the other being the disputed April 1876 mayoral election). As a result of the Common Council declaring the result of the city's March 1844 mayoral election null and void, a second election was held in April.

zh.s: 芝加哥1844年市长选举是该市仅有的两次被宣布无效的市长选举之一；另一次是1876年4月那场有争议的选举。市议会宣布1844年3月的选举结果无效后，4月又举行了一次选举。

en.t: King Charles Albert of Sardinia signs the Statuto Albertino, which would later serve as the constitution for the Kingdom of Italy
en.s: The Statuto Albertino (English: Albertine Statute) was the constitution granted by King Charles Albert of Sardinia to the Kingdom of Sardinia on 4 March 1848 and written in Italian and French. Promulgated at the height of the Risorgimento, the process of Italian unification, the Statute was gradually extended to the other territories incorporated into the new state and was officially recognized as the fundamental law of the Kingdom of Italy upon its proclamation on 17 March 1861.

zh.t: 撒丁国王查理·阿尔贝托签署《阿尔贝蒂诺宪章》
zh.s: 《阿尔贝蒂诺宪章》是撒丁国王查理·阿尔贝托授予撒丁王国的一部宪法，于1848年3月4日以意大利语和法语写成并颁布。当时意大利统一运动正值高潮。随着撒丁王国逐渐兼并其他领土，这部宪章也逐步扩展适用范围；1861年3月17日意大利王国宣布成立后，它正式成为王国的基本法。

en.t: Abraham Lincoln is inaugurated as U.S. president
en.s: On March 4, 1861, Abraham Lincoln took the oath of office as the 16th president of the United States and delivered his first inaugural address in Washington, D.C.

zh.t: 亚伯拉罕·林肯宣誓就任美国总统
zh.s: 1861年3月4日，亚伯拉罕·林肯在华盛顿宣誓就任美国第16任总统，并发表首次就职演说。

en.s: The Battle of Pieskowa Skała, one of many skirmishes of the January Uprising, took place on 4 March 1863 near Pieskowa Skała in southwestern corner of Russian-controlled Congress Poland. A party of Polish insurgents commanded by Marian Langiewicz, heading towards the border with Galicia (Austrian Partition of Poland), clashed with units of the Imperial Russian Army.

zh.s: 皮斯科瓦斯卡瓦战役是波兰一月起义期间多场小规模战斗之一。1863年3月4日，马里安·兰盖维奇率领一支波兰起义军向加利西亚（波兰被奥地利瓜分的部分）边境前进，在今波兰西南部、当时由俄国控制的国会波兰皮斯科瓦斯卡瓦附近与俄帝国军队交战。

en.s: The 1865 Tennessee gubernatorial election was held on March 4, 1865, to elect the next governor of Tennessee. The Unconditional Union candidate Parson Brownlow was elected virtually without opposition. Incumbent Democratic governor Andrew Johnson was appointed by Abraham Lincoln on March 12, 1862, as a military governor. Johnson's Unionist government emerged following a series of Union military victories that reclaimed most of Tennessee.

zh.s: 田纳西州于1865年3月4日举行州长选举，无条件联合派候选人“牧师”布朗洛几乎没有对手地当选。时任民主党州长安德鲁·约翰逊，于1862年3月12日获亚伯拉罕·林肯任命为军事州长。在联邦军连续取胜、收复田纳西大部分地区后，约翰逊的亲联邦政府得以建立。

en.t: Swan Lake premieres at Moscow’s Bolshoi Theatre
en.s: On 4 March 1877 in the Gregorian calendar (20 February in the Russian Julian calendar), Pyotr Tchaikovsky’s ballet Swan Lake premiered at Moscow’s Bolshoi Theatre. Pelageya Karpakova danced Odette and Victor Gillert danced Prince Siegfried.
en.n: March 4 in the Gregorian calendar corresponds to February 20 in the Russian Julian calendar.

zh.t: 《天鹅湖》在莫斯科大剧院首演
zh.s: 1877年3月4日（俄历2月20日），柴可夫斯基的芭蕾舞剧《天鹅湖》在莫斯科大剧院首演。佩拉盖娅·卡尔帕科娃饰演奥杰塔，维克托·吉列尔特饰演齐格弗里德。
zh.n: 俄历1877年2月20日对应公历3月4日。

en.s: The Battle of Lëkurës, also known as the Lëkurës War, was an armed engagement in Lëkurës (present-day Albania) in 1878, between Greek forces and Albanian irregulars.
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 莱库雷斯战役又称莱库雷斯战争，是1878年希腊军队与阿尔巴尼亚非正规武装在莱库雷斯（今阿尔巴尼亚）发生的一场武装冲突。
zh.n: 此条记录采用原文资料框列明的事件结束日期。

en.t: Leo XIII’s letter provides for the restoration of Scotland’s Catholic hierarchy
en.s: Pope Leo XIII’s apostolic letter Ex Supremo, dated March 4, 1878, provided for the restoration of the Catholic hierarchy in Scotland. It established the Archdiocese of St Andrews and Edinburgh.
en.n: This entry uses the date of the papal letter, rather than treating every stage of implementation as occurring that day.

zh.t: 良十三世以宗座牧函恢复苏格兰天主教主教体系
zh.s: 教宗良十三世在日期为1878年3月4日的宗座牧函《Ex Supremo》中，规定恢复苏格兰天主教会的主教体系，并设立圣安德鲁斯和爱丁堡总教区。
zh.n: 此处按宗座牧函的日期记录，并非指各项安排都在当天实施。

en.s: Cyclone Mahina was the deadliest cyclone in recorded Australian history, and also potentially the most intense tropical cyclone ever recorded in the Southern Hemisphere. Mahina struck Bathurst Bay, Cape York Peninsula, colonial Queensland, on 4 March 1899, and its winds and enormous storm surge combined to cause the deaths of more than 300 people.

zh.s: 马希纳气旋是澳大利亚有记录以来致死人数最多的气旋，也可能是南半球有记录以来最强的热带气旋。1899年3月4日，马希纳气旋袭击约克角半岛巴瑟斯特湾一带的昆士兰殖民地，强风和巨大的风暴潮造成300多人死亡。

en.s: The second inauguration of William McKinley as president of the United States was held on Monday, March 4, 1901, at the East Portico of the United States Capitol in Washington, D.C. This was the 29th inauguration and marked the commencement of the second and final term of William McKinley as president and the only term of Theodore Roosevelt as vice president.

zh.t: 威廉·麦金莱第二次总统就职典礼
zh.s: 1901年3月4日星期一，威廉·麦金莱在华盛顿美国国会大厦东侧门廊，第二次宣誓就任总统。这是美国第29次总统就职典礼，标志着麦金莱第二个、也是最后一个总统任期，以及西奥多·罗斯福唯一的副总统任期开始。

en.s: The Collinwood school fire (also known as the Lake View School fire) erupted on March 4, 1908. 172 students, two teachers, and one rescuer died in one of the deadliest school disasters in US history.

zh.s: 1908年3月4日，科林伍德学校，也称湖景学校发生火灾，造成172名学生、2名教师及1名救援人员死亡，是美国历史上死亡人数最多的校园灾难之一。

en.t: Taft signs the law creating the U.S. Department of Labor
en.s: On 4 March 1913, President William Howard Taft signed the law establishing the U.S. Department of Labor, shortly before leaving office.

zh.t: 塔夫脱签署法案，成立美国劳工部
zh.s: 1913年3月4日，威廉·霍华德·塔夫脱总统签署法案，成立美国劳工部。此时他即将卸任。

en.s: The First Battle of Topolobampo was a bloodless engagement and one of the few naval battles of the Mexican Revolution. The small action occurred off Topolobampo, Mexico and involved three gunboats, two from the Mexican Navy and another which mutinied from the armada and joined the rebel Constitutionalists. It was fought on the morning of March 4, 1914 and was the first battle of the naval campaign in the Gulf of California.

zh.t: 第一次托波洛班波海战
zh.s: 1914年3月4日上午，墨西哥托波洛班波外海发生一场没有流血的交战，是墨西哥革命中少数海战之一，也是加利福尼亚湾海上战事的第一战。三艘炮舰参战，其中两艘属于墨西哥海军，另一艘已叛离舰队，加入反政府的宪政派。

en.s: The 1915 Yukon general election was held on March 4 to elect the ten members of the Yukon Territorial Council. The members were chosen from five different electoral districts with the two most popular winning seats Plurality block voting.

zh.s: 1915年3月4日，育空举行大选，选出育空地区议会的10名议员。议员来自5个选区，每个选区得票最多的两人当选，采用区块多数制。

en.t: Jeannette Rankin’s term in the U.S. House begins
en.s: Jeannette Rankin’s term as a U.S. representative from Montana began on 4 March 1917, making her the first woman to serve in Congress. She was sworn in on 2 April 1917.
en.n: This records the start of Rankin’s congressional term; she took the oath on April 2, 1917.

zh.t: 珍妮特·兰金开始担任美国众议员
zh.s: 1917年3月4日，珍妮特·兰金开始担任蒙大拿州联邦众议员，成为美国国会首位女性议员。她于同年4月2日宣誓就职。
zh.n: 此条记录的是兰金众议员任期开始日；她在1917年4月2日宣誓就职。

en.s: The North Russia intervention, also known as the Northern Russian expedition, the Archangel campaign, and the Murman deployment, was part of the Allied intervention in the Russian Civil War after the October Revolution. The intervention brought about the involvement of foreign troops in the Russian Civil War on the side of the White movement.
en.n: This entry records the event's start date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 北俄干涉又称俄罗斯北方远征、阿尔汉格尔斯克战役和摩尔曼部署，是十月革命后协约国干涉俄国内战的一部分。此次干涉使外国军队加入俄国内战，支持白军。
zh.n: 此条记录采用原文资料框列明的事件开始日期。

en.s: The Kirkcaldy Burghs by-election of 1921 was held on 4 March 1921. The by-election was held due to the resignation of the incumbent Coalition Liberal MP, James Henry Dalziel. It was won by the Labour candidate Tom Kennedy.

zh.s: 1921年3月4日，英国柯科迪自治市选区举行补选，填补联合政府自由党议员詹姆斯·亨利·达尔齐尔辞职留下的空缺。工党候选人汤姆·肯尼迪当选。

en.s: The Sheemore ambush was an ambush carried out by the Irish Republican Army (IRA) on 4 March 1921, during the Irish War of Independence. It took place at Sheemore near Carrick-on-Shannon, County Leitrim. The ambush was carried out by the IRA's South Leitrim Brigade on a British Army and Auxiliary Division convoy. The British force suffered casualties and admitted one fatality, a captain in the Bedfordshire Regiment, although some local sources claimed several more were killed.

en.s: The 1921 All-Ireland Senior Hurling Championship Final was the 34th final of the All-Ireland Senior Hurling Championship, the top inter-county hurling competition in Ireland. The match was contested between Dublin and Limerick at Croke Park on 4 March 1923. Not only was it the first All-Ireland final to feature the two teams, but it was also their first championship meeting.

en.s: The self-elimination of Parliament (German: Selbstausschaltung des Parlaments) was a constitutional crisis in the First Austrian Republic caused by the resignation on March 4, 1933, of all three presidents of the National Council, the more powerful house of the Austrian Parliament. The National Council was left without a presiding officer, when all three chairmen resigned to try to tip the balance in a knife-edge vote.

en.s: Operation Claymore was the codename for a British Commandos raid on the Lofoten Islands in Norway during the Second World War. The Lofoten Islands were an important centre for the production of fish oil and glycerine, used in the German war industry. The landings were carried out on 4 March 1941, by the men of No. 3 Commando, No. 4 Commando, a Royal Engineers Section and 52 men from the Royal Norwegian Navy. Supported by the 6th Destroyer Flotilla and two troop transports of the Royal Navy, the force made an unopposed landing and generally continued to meet no opposition.

en.s: The Battle of Fardykambos (Greek: Μάχη του Φαρδύκαμπου), also known as the Battle of Bougazi (Μάχη στο Μπουγάζι), was fought between the National Liberation Front (EAM-ELAS) of the Greek Resistance against the Italian troops during the Axis Occupation of Greece. The battle was notable for the large-scale and spontaneous participation of the local populace, and of officers from other groups and organizations, including right-wing rivals to ELAS. The three-day battle began with the successful ambush of an Italian transport column on 4 March 1943.

en.s: Operation Gisela (German: Unternehmen Gisela) was the code name for a German military operation of the Second World War. Gisela was an intruder operation against RAF Bomber Command during the Defence of the Reich campaign. It was the last big operation launched by the Luftwaffe Nachtjagdgeschwader (Night Fighter Wings) during the conflict. By March 1945 the Luftwaffe had lost air superiority over all fronts. Western Allied air forces held air supremacy over the German Reich and remaining German-occupied territory. German industrial cities were now subjected to intensive bombardment which inflicted enormous damage on the German war effort. The United States Army Air Forces attacked by day, while RAF Bomber Command operated by night. Allied armies had overrun some German towns and cities. The defeat in Normandy and the Allied advance across Western Europe broke the Kammhuber Line through occupied France, Belgium and the Netherlands and much of its early warning network had been lost. The Luftwaffe failed to produce enough night fighter crews, exacerbated by the fuel shortage that contributed to the collapse of training programs and grounded combat units. RAF de Havilland Mosquito night fighter intruders operated over Germany against such nightighters that took off. Experienced night fighter commanders and pilots suggested a return to intruder operations over England. In 1940–1941, German night fighters had flown intruder sorties to attack RAF bombers as they tried to land. Adolf Hitler had ordered a cessation of these activities for propaganda and practical reasons but the operations had met with reasonable success and it was felt they might do so again. Hermann Göring, commander-in-chief of the Luftwaffe, sanctioned the operation. An opportunity occurred on the night of the 3/4 March 1945, when Bomber Command attacked targets in western Germany.

zh.s: 吉塞拉行动是二战期间德国的一次军事行动，目标是在英国上空袭击英国皇家空军轰炸机司令部，是德国防空战的一部分，也是德国夜间战斗机部队发动的最后一次大型行动。1945年3月，德国空军已失去各条战线的制空权，盟军控制了德国及仍被德国占领的地区。美国陆军航空队白天轰炸，英国皇家空军轰炸机司令部则在夜间出动，德国工业城市遭到猛烈轰炸。诺曼底战役失利和盟军在西欧的推进，打破了德国在法国、比利时和荷兰设置的卡姆胡贝尔防线，其预警网络也大多被摧毁。德国空军因缺少燃油，无法培养足够的夜间战斗机机组，训练项目停摆，作战部队也被迫停飞。英国皇家空军的蚊式夜间战斗机在德国上空拦截起飞的德国夜间战斗机。经验丰富的德国夜间战斗机指挥官和飞行员建议恢复对英国的突袭行动。1940至1941年间，德国夜间战斗机曾袭击准备降落的英国轰炸机，效果尚可；希特勒后来以宣传和实际因素为由下令停止行动。空军总司令赫尔曼·戈林批准了这次行动。1945年3月3日至4日夜间，英国轰炸机司令部袭击德国西部目标，为行动创造了机会。

en.s: Presidential elections were held in El Salvador on 4 March 1956. The result was a victory for José María Lemus of the Revolutionary Party of Democratic Unification, who received 95.2% of the vote. The Central Electoral Council had disqualified the candidacies of José Alberto Funes (Democratic Institutional Party), Roberto Edmundo Cannessa (National Action Party) and José Alvaro Díaz (Nationalist Democratic Party). It also forbade Rafael Carranza Anaya (Authentic Constitutional Party) and Enrique Magaña Menéndez (Renovated Action Party) from withdrawing their candidacies; nevertheless, the latter two boycotted the elections.

en.s: The French freighter La Coubre exploded in the harbor of Havana, Cuba, on 4 March 1960 while it was unloading 76 tons of munitions. Casualties may have been as high as 100, and many more were injured. Fidel Castro charged it was an act of sabotage on the part of the United States, which denied any involvement. Unloading explosive ordnance directly onto the dock in Havana was against port regulations. Ships with such cargoes were supposed to be moored in the center of the harbor and their high-risk cargo unloaded onto lighters.

en.t: Merlyn Rees announces the dissolution of the Northern Ireland Constitutional Convention

zh.s: 1976年3月4日，北爱尔兰事务大臣梅林·里斯宣布解散北爱尔兰宪政会议，3月6日生效。北爱尔兰继续实行英国政府直接管治。

en.s: The 1977 Vrancea earthquake occurred on Friday, 4 March 1977, at 21:22 local time, and was felt throughout the Balkans. It had a magnitude of 7.2, making it the second most powerful earthquake recorded in Romania in the 20th century, after 10 November 1940 seismic event. The epicenter was situated in the Vrancea Mountains, the most seismically active part of Romania, at a depth of 94 km. The earthquake killed about 1,578 people (1,424 in Bucharest) in Romania, and wounded more than 11,300. Among the victims were actor Toma Caragiu and writers A. E. Bakonsky, Alexandru Ivasiuc and Corneliu M.

zh.s: 1977年3月4日星期五当地时间21时22分，罗马尼亚发生7.2级弗朗恰地震，巴尔干半岛各地均有震感。震中位于罗马尼亚地震最活跃的弗朗恰山脉，震源深94公里，是该国20世纪有记录以来第二强的地震，仅次于1940年11月10日地震。罗马尼亚约1578人死亡，其中布加勒斯特1424人，另有11300多人受伤。遇难者包括演员托马·卡拉久，以及作家A.E.巴孔斯基、亚历山德鲁·伊瓦修克等。原文在另一位作家姓名“科尔内留·M.”处中断。

en.s: The Battle of Tororo was a battle of the Uganda–Tanzania War that took place from 2 to 4 March 1979 at Tororo, Uganda and its surroundings. It was fought between Ugandan rebels loyal to Milton Obote and Uganda Army units loyal to President Idi Amin. In an attempt to destabilise Amin's rule and capture weapons for an insurrection, a group of guerrillas launched a raid from Kenya against Tororo, whose garrison partially mutinied and joined them after a brief fight.

en.s: The 1980 Massachusetts Democratic presidential primary was held on March 4, 1980. As part of the 1980 Democratic Party presidential primaries for the 1980 United States presidential election, this was the fourth primary since Iowa, Maine and New Hampshire. 112 pledged delegates to the 1980 Democratic National Convention were allocated to presidential candidates. U.S. Senator Ted Kennedy defeated incumbent President Jimmy Carter surprised by 78 pledged delegates and 590,404 popular votes.

zh.s: 马萨诸塞州于1980年3月4日举行民主党总统初选，是艾奥瓦、缅因及新罕布什尔之后的第四场提名投票，分配全国代表大会的112名承诺代表。参议员特德·肯尼迪击败现任总统吉米·卡特，获得78名承诺代表及590404张选票。

en.s: General elections were held in Southern Rhodesia between 14 February and 4 March 1980 to elect the members of the House of Assembly of the first Parliament of the independent Zimbabwe. As stipulated by the new Constitution of Zimbabwe produced by the Lancaster House Conference, the new House of Assembly was to comprise 100 members, 80 of whom would be elected proportionally by province by all adult citizens on a common roll, and 20 of whom would be elected in single-member constituencies by whites on a separate roll.

zh.s: 南罗得西亚于1980年2月14日至3月4日举行大选，选出津巴布韦独立后第一届议会众议院议员。根据兰开斯特宫会议制定的新津巴布韦宪法，众议院共设100席：80席由所有成年公民按省份比例选出，另20席由白人选民在单席选区中选出。

en.s: The Belfast South by-election was held on 4 March 1982 following the death of Robert Bradford, Ulster Unionist Party (UUP) Member of Parliament for Belfast South. Bradford had held the seat since the February 1974 general election, initially for the Vanguard Progressive Unionist Party, but since 1978 as a UUP member. He was murdered by the Provisional IRA on 14 November 1981 while holding a political surgery in a community centre in Finaghy. Unusually, the Seanad Éireann passed a motion of sympathy for his death.

zh.s: 1982年3月4日，英国贝尔法斯特南选区举行补选，填补阿尔斯特统一党议员罗伯特·布拉德福德去世留下的空缺。他自1974年2月大选以来担任该区议员，最初代表先锋进步统一党，1978年起加入阿尔斯特统一党。1981年11月14日，他在菲纳吉一座社区中心接见选民时，被爱尔兰共和军临时派杀害。爱尔兰参议院罕见地通过了哀悼动议。

This was the first direct election by voters in the Australian Capital Territory (ACT) for their power legislative body. The Labor Party, led by Rosemary Follett, and the Liberal Party, led by Trevor Kaine, were the main challengers. Candidates were elected to fill seats using modified d'Hondt electoral system for a multi-member single (at-large) constituency.

en.s: The 1990 Ukrainian local elections took place on 4 March 1990 when Ukraine, as the Ukrainian SSR, was still a part of the Soviet Union. The Ukrainian nationalist opposition People's Movement of Ukraine (Rukh) won majorities in the elections of the city councils of Lviv and Kyiv and was successful in western Ukraine.

en.t: American basketball player Hank Gathers dies after collapsing during the semifinals of a West Coast Conference tournament game
en.s: Eric Wilson "Hank" Gathers Jr. (February 11, 1967 – March 4, 1990) was an American college basketball player for the Loyola Marymount Lions. en.s: The Weyauwega derailment was a railroad accident that occurred in Weyauwega, Wisconsin, USA, in the early morning hours of March 4, 1996. The derailed train was carrying a large quantity of hazardous material, which immediately caught fire. The fire, which involved the train cars and an adjacent feed mill, burned for more than two weeks after the actual derailment, resulting in the emergency evacuation of 2,300 people for 16 days, including the entire city of Weyauwega, with about 1,700 evacuees.

en.s: The Battle of Same (4 March 2007) was fought in the village of Same in Timor Leste, 50 kilometres (31 mi) south of the capital Dili, between Australian Special Forces and Petitioner rebels under the command of Alfredo Reinado. The operation occurred under the auspices of Operation Astute, being the deployment of Australian forces in the wake of 2006 East Timorese crisis, and resulted in the Australians successfully securing the target compound and defeating the small rebel force, before the assault was called off by the Timor Leste government. Reinado and nine other rebels subsequently evaded the Australian cordon, however, and made good their escape into the mountains.

en.s: Parliamentary elections were held in Estonia on 4 March 2007. en.s: Presidential elections were held in Togo on 4 March 2010. Incumbent President Faure Gnassingbé—who won his first term in a presidential election that followed the death of his father, long-time President Gnassingbé Eyadema, in 2005—faced radical opposition candidate Jean-Pierre Fabre, the Secretary-General of the Union of the Forces of Change (UFC), as well as several minor opposition candidates. Following the democratization process of the early 1990s, which proved largely abortive, Eyadema and his ruling party, the Rally of the Togolese People (RPT), successively won all presidential elections, although those elections were always extremely controversial: the opposition boycotted the 1993 presidential election altogether, and it claimed that Eyadema won the 1998 presidential election and the 2003 presidential election only through fraud.

zh.s: 多哥于2010年3月4日举行总统选举。现任总统福雷·纳辛贝在父亲、长期总统纳辛贝·埃亚德马2005年去世后赢得首个任期，这次面对激进反对派候选人、变革力量联盟秘书长让-皮埃尔·法布尔，以及数名较小反对派候选人挑战。20世纪90年代初，多哥曾推动民主化，但大体未能成功，埃亚德马及其执政的多哥人民联盟此后赢得每次总统选举，过程却始终争议极大。反对派完全抵制1993年总统选举，并指称埃亚德马在1998年及2003年均靠舞弊获胜。

en.s: A general election was held in Samoa on 4 March 2011, in which the people elected the 49 seats of the Fono for its 15th term. en.s: General elections were held in Samoa on 4 March 2016. The main contesting parties were that of incumbent Prime Minister Tuilaepa Sailele Malielegaoi, of the Human Rights Protection Party (HRPP); and the Tautua Samoa Party (TSP). The HRPP secured a landslide victory, winning 35 of the 49 elected seats in the Legislative Assembly, while 12 independents subsequently joined them, strengthening Samoa's one-party rule and preventing the TSP from obtaining the eight seats required for recognition as a parliamentary party.

zh.s: 萨摩亚于2016年3月4日举行大选，主要竞争者为现任总理图伊拉埃帕·赛莱莱·马利埃莱高伊人权保护党，以及萨摩亚服务党。人权保护党在49个民选议席中赢得35席，取得压倒性胜利，随后12名独立议员也加入该党。这进一步加强萨摩亚一党主导的局面，使服务党无法达到获得正式议会政党地位所需的8席。

en.s: The 2017 Tajik Supercup was the 8th Tajik Supercup, an annual Tajik football match played between the winners of the previous season's Tajik League and Tajik Cup. zh.s: 2017年塔吉克斯坦超级杯是第8届塔吉克斯坦超级杯。这项一年一度的比赛由上赛季塔吉克斯坦联赛和杯赛冠军对阵。此次参赛双方为2016年联赛和杯赛冠军伊斯提克洛尔，以及2016年杯赛亚军霍西洛特·法尔霍尔。比赛在希萨尔中央体育场举行，时间为2017年塔吉克斯坦联赛首场比赛的前一天。

en.s: Lombardy renewed its delegation to the Italian Senate on March 4, 2018. This election was a part of national Italian general election of 2018 even if, according to the Italian Constitution, every senatorial challenge in each Region is a single and independent race. en.s: The Lazio regional election of 2018 took place in Lazio, Italy, on 4 March 2018, concurrently with the Italian general election and the Lombard regional election. The election was won by centre-left incumbent President Nicola Zingaretti, with just under a third of the vote, over the centre-right one Stefano Parisi, who gain 31%, and the Five Star Movement's candidate Roberta Lombardi with 27%.

en.s: The 2018 Italian general election was held on 4 March 2018 after the Italian Parliament was dissolved by President Sergio Mattarella on 28 December 2017.
